description: 75 A regression baseline for the converged steel ESIM Karl iteration on the regenerated Kelvin skin mesh.

sample.note: Gapped torus A-V coil, workpiece SIBC and Kelvin exterior. Cubit-regenerated mesh with 246108 elements.

notes: The June ESIM depth mesh under-resolved the steel skin depth. The current depth solver was checked against the constant-permeability analytic impedance.
The B-H curve is interpolated between the origin and first measured point (13.898 A/m); that segment has no low-field measurements. Fractions apply to the steel surface under the uniform-Zs model.
The final A-V port gauge gave 39.65 nH in a separate air-coil check. BEM-A including surface reactance gave 39.91–40.00 nH and the old gauge gave 28.01 nH.

This golden covers the specified discrete model. Convergence of physical coil loss is not established by matching the coarse case. The steel case at fixed Z_s gave coil losses of 1.0929, 1.0714, and 1.1566 W on successive refinements. The final refinement increased the loss by 7.95%, so mesh convergence of coil loss remains unestablished.
